articles.title: Let the words be the last thing you hear
articles.dek: A few quiet choices before sleep can turn scripture into something your body begins to expect and welcome.

articles.title: Psalm 23 in four genres: how the room changes what you hear
articles.dek: The same twenty-three verses sound entirely different depending on the musical world you bring them into, and that difference is worth paying attention to.

articles.title: Why singing scripture makes it stick
articles.dek: Melody does something to memory that reading alone rarely can, and the psalms have always known this.
